$comment: Zenith's half of the agent-board mapping. COMMITTED, and this repo
owns it. Everything a ticket is judged by — gate command lines,
pinned unit baselines, conventions, categories, living-doc dirs —
lives here, beside the code it judges. This file is sent to the board
with every request.
The board keeps only POLICY (the agent account, complexity->model
routing, timeouts) and may be on an entirely different machine. It
holds no path into this filesystem: `project` below declares which
board project this checkout serves, rather than a config elsewhere
declaring where the checkout lives. That inversion is the only
direction that survives the two being on separate machines.
WHY the gates live here: a pinned unit count already had three homes
in this repo (Games/*/Docs/Status.md, .github/workflows/*.yml,
Tools/run_unit_gate.ps1) and those move together in one commit
because a reviewer can see them. A fourth pin in another repo's
gitignored file could only be remembered, and a ticket that ratchets
against a stale pin fails with ZERO failing tests — the unit gate
asserts `ran == Baseline` EXACTLY, so a suite that GREW reds a
required check while every test passes.
`protectedPaths` are UNIONed with the board's floor, never swapped
for it: this repo may add protections to itself and can never drop
the board's. `$`-prefixed keys are comments and are stripped.
This file is itself protected: the loop may propose changes to its
own gates as a Suggestions row, never commit them.
conventions: Root CLAUDE.md is binding. No std:: containers; every .cpp starts with #include "Zenith.h"; tabs; braces on new lines; Zenith_Assert is the real assert (ZENITH_ASSERT is an empty marker). Never run Sharpmake in a worktree.

$comment: -Baseline 3354 is the ZM boot unit count. It moves with, and must
equal, the counts in Games/Zenithmon/Docs/Status.md and
.github/workflows/zm-tests.yml. Read it from a NULL-config exe —
the Vulkan exe reports a higher number for the same tree.
Zenithmon.conventions: Games/Zenithmon/CLAUDE.md + Docs/AgentBriefing.md are binding. ZM_ prefix. NEVER create a branch, PR, or worktree (ZM-D-031).

$comment: -Baseline 1638 is the engine boot count via Null Combat, and it is
ALSO the default of Tools/run_unit_gate.ps1's -Baseline parameter.
A backend-neutral engine unit moves EVERY game's pin, not just this
one — see the conventions string below.
Engine.conventions: Engine work moves EVERY game's pinned unit count if it adds a backend-neutral engine unit - the ticket's Definition of Done must list every pinned site.

DevilsPlayground.$comment: Overrides the project's `direct` branching — DP's Docs/CIPolicy.md is a squash-merge policy.
DevilsPlayground.conventions: Games/DevilsPlayground/Docs are binding; no paid/external services.

$comment: Every CLAUDE.md in the repo (root + every leaf module), mirrored
into its own Notion section — separate from the per-game Docs trees
above, and PROJECT-wide rather than one category's. Kept in sync by
the tick's step 9 (see tick.md) whenever a ticket's diff touches a
Docs/** path or any CLAUDE.md.
